question_text: For each demo booth (DemoBooth_NVIDIA and DemoBooth_Intel), what was the peak head_count observed on 2025-12-08 (UTC)?
answer_text: The peak head count observed on 2025-12-08 (UTC) was 86 at DemoBooth_NVIDIA and 53 at DemoBooth_Intel.

citations.cypher:
MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)-[:AT_CAMERA]->(c:Camera)-[:LOCATED_AT]->(:Location {name: 'DemoBooth_NVIDIA'}) 
WHERE ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z' 
RETURN c.camera_location AS demo_booth, MAX(ch.peak_hc) AS peak_head_count
UNION
MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)-[:AT_CAMERA]->(c:Camera)-[:LOCATED_AT]->(:Location {name: 'DemoBooth_Intel'}) 
WHERE ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z' 
RETURN c.camera_location AS demo_booth, MAX(ch.peak_hc) AS peak_head_count
